body:
Hey everyone! Our classic Days of Christmas event is beginning now. This is very similar to previous years, and you can get all of the info by running `/christmas` in-game, but for a quick overview:

  • To start, build your fireplace (a fire block with at least two adjacent solid blocks) and register it with `/christmas fireplace`.

  • A present spawns near your fireplace upon your first daily login starting December 14th. The date is checked in Eastern Time for this event.

  • There are 12 presents, though the event runs for through December 31st, so there's plenty of leeway if you miss a day.

  • Many presents are quite valuable, and some are unique to the event. Everyone gets the same presents in the same order.

Happy holidays to you all! 🎅

🏭Contest Reminder

Reminder that Factory build contest entries are due in just over 3 hours. It's better to submit it unfinished than not at all!
